plugin.name: Inertia.js Support
plugin.description: Inertia.js support for PhpStorm 2026.2: navigation from Inertia::render(), inertia() and Route::inertia(), page name completion, Svelte 5 $props() completion and an opt-in inspection for props the page does not declare.
plugin.change-notes:
0.2.0

  • Ported to PhpStorm 2026.2.4 (262.*), IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.19, Kotlin 2.4, JDK 21
  • PHP 8 named arguments in Inertia::render(), inertia() and Route::inertia()
  • Prop key completion from the $props() of the target Svelte 5 page
  • Opt-in inspection for props the Svelte page does not declare
  • Page resolution and completion now use direct VFS lookup and FilenameIndex
